```python
import numpy as np
W1 = np.random.randn(128, 128).astype(np.float32) * 0.05
W2 = np.random.randn(128, 59).astype(np.float32) * 0.05
def forward(x):
    h = np.tanh(x @ W1)
    logits = h @ W2
    exp = np.exp(logits - logits.max(axis=-1, keepdims=True))
    return exp / exp.sum(axis=-1, keepdims=True)
```
